text: かたそうな　いわ　だけど……　ポケモンの　わざで　こわせるかも？

structure.jp: かたそうな　いわ　だけど……
ポケモンの　わざで

patterns.name: 〜かもしれない
patterns.explanation: かも is the short form of かもしれない, 'maybe'. こわせるかも = 'maybe it can be broken'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう stuck onto a describing word means 'looks that way'; with な it describes the thing that follows. かたそうな　いわ = 'a hard-looking rock'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing こわす 'break' to こわせる gives the meaning 'can break'. こわせる = 'can break it'.
